EmailTemplate.name: Interdisciplinary Arts & Sciences BA
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Future Sun Devil,
Thank you for expressing interest in the Interdisciplinary Arts & Sciences (BA) <https://newcollege.asu.edu/interdisciplinary-arts-and-sciences-degree> program at Arizona State University. A variation of the classic liberal arts degree, students combine lower-division foundational courses with upper-division courses in a specific area of concentration unique to their interests and career goals. The concentration can include, but is not limited to, business, communication, criminal justice, education, environmental issues and physical sciences, languages and cultures, and social sciences and policy issues. Students usually look to work in Human resources, Non-profit sector, Education, Law, Social Work, and Public policy among many other areas. By viewing the major map <https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/roadmaps/ASU00/ASIASBA/null/ALL/2016>, you can see the degree requirements outlined for graduation.
Be sure to review our admission and application requirements <https://students.asu.edu/freshman/requirements> for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format. For information on how to pay for college, please visit our scholarships page<https://newcollege.asu.edu/college-scholarships>.
It's important to find the right fit for your undergraduate program. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can visit ASU and register for a tour <https://visit.asu.edu/>.
We can’t wait to see you here at West campus! If you have any questions about New College, West campus, or one of our 35 programs, please contact our Recruitment Office through the information listed below. Thank you, and we’ll talk to you soon!
Kindest Regards,
New College Recruitment Team New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus asknewcollege@asu.edu 602-543-2890 {!Case.Thread_Id}
